title: Bind internal bot authentication to one authoritative runtime tenant
out_of_scope: deploy / cloud / database / Stripe / WhatsApp / production operations

getAccessibleClientSlugs.bot_principal: staff_user_id===luna-bot-internal → [bound client_slug] or [] if unbound; never all baseline

wolfhouse_staff_api.LUNA_BOT_CLIENT_SLUG: set to this deployment tenant slug (e.g. wolfhouse-somo)
wolfhouse_staff_api.DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG: optional compat only when nonempty and equal; must not conflict

sunset_staff_api.LUNA_BOT_CLIENT_SLUG: set to this deployment tenant slug (e.g. sunset)
sunset_staff_api.DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG: optional compat only when nonempty and equal; must not conflict

rollout_env_requirement.note: Each Staff API runtime that enables LUNA_BOT_INTERNAL_TOKEN must set LUNA_BOT_CLIENT_SLUG (or a consistent nonempty DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG). Missing/invalid/conflicting values fail closed with 503 on bot-token auth.

residual_risk.summary: Generic /staff/bot/* handlers may still trust body/query client_slug independently of the bound principal; Sunset force-tenant routes are asymmetric. 15E closes principal/ACL only.
